This is a different transfer scenario, so the trigger does not continue into the main flow.

[mainflow_postconditions_reachability] The main flow is written entirely for an emergency point, while postconditions include R² outcomes for tracks, ballistic missile tracks, and launch points. The emergency-point flow cannot reach those track-specific postconditions.

Main flow only covers: existing report information, operator-action reporting with the same TN reference, assuming R² as latest reporter, and the previous reporter ceasing. The referenced attachment point is therefore nonexistent.
